stages.name: Intake
stages.prompt: Translate the user's request into a precise engineering objective, constraints and acceptance criteria.

stages.name: Reconnaissance
stages.prompt: Identify the evidence required to understand the current system. Never invent repository facts.

stages.name: Architecture
stages.prompt: Map the objective to likely components, interfaces, dependencies and technical risks.

stages.name: Plan
stages.prompt: Create the smallest safe implementation plan with ordered changes and acceptance criteria.

stages.name: Implementation
stages.prompt: Describe the concrete production-quality code changes that should be made.

stages.name: Audit
stages.prompt: Adversarially inspect the proposed solution for regressions, security issues, edge cases and weak assumptions.

stages.name: Validation
stages.prompt: Define tests and checks that prove the objective is satisfied and distinguish executable checks from evidence still required.

stages.name: PR Preparation
stages.prompt: Prepare a review-ready pull request proposal with title, summary, affected files, validation, risks and reviewer checklist.
